title: Unit Event — Grow Glorious Glow — Episode7 Aura

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! haven't received any job offers in a while, but one day, an email arrives for Shizuku. It invites her to audition for popular cosmetics brand Grand Fleur's new commercial...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Move that chair about ten centimeters to your right for me.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Okay! Is this light good where it is?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've actually left no stone unturned this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (All that's left is for me to give this shoot everything I have.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Shizuku said that her shoot's today, but where could she be...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I came to give her some words of encouragement, but I guess that's not going to be necessary.)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
First, we'll be doing a close-up cut.
You're on standby, Hagiyama.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing a good performance out of you today, Hagiyama.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Her presence has increased since the audition...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She really is an incredible talent...
I mean, her eyes... I'm afraid to even take a breath right now.)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Okay! Nice work, Hagiyama.
That was a solid take!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Next, Hinomori, we need you on standby!

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Hagiyama's on top of her game today.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: All that's left is to see how Hinomori responds.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Okay!
Looks like everyone else is also ready! Are the cameras ready to roll?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not just where I'm going to stand in terms of this commercial.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But also the future of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to throw everything I have into this moment.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to use my eyes, lips, fingers and everything else to fully express myself.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This is how overwhelming Shizuku Hinomori's presence can be!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm nothing like what I was back then.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm not being made to shoulder my group.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We're all working together to share the load as we move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right now, I want to carry them all on my back...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to carry MORE MORE JUMP! into the future!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I still don't actually know what people mean when they say that.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I believe it's a kind of brilliance that appears when a person's ironclad resolve is supported with an immeasurable amount of hard work.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I can shine even brighter now.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I'm prepared to carry everyone forward.
I worked incredibly hard leading up to this day.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So, I will glow brighter than anyone!)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting her to shine this brightly...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Is this the Shizuku Hinomori you saw back then, Oikawa?

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: This goes far beyond what I saw.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that Mr. Oikawa said our commercial is sure to turn out well...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I guess that means I did a good job.)

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: You were really spectacular today, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: I couldn't take my eyes off of you. The way you used your body was so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
And your presence...
I was totally overwhelmed.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: I still have a lot of work left to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I'm the one who still has a lot of work left to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Between my current skill level and attitude, I have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You made me realize that, and helped me to improve myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, thank you.
I'm glad that I was able to work on this commercial with you, Hagiyama.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Me too. I'm glad it was you I got to work with.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, you surprised me a little during the audition...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: It's just... The current you seemed completely different from Shizuku Hinomori from Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: But you made me rethink all of that today.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
You're still the Shizuku Hinomori I remember.
You're the lead who took Cheerful * Days to the next level.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Nevermind. I look forward to working with you again.
